extract_fields.GGN: the 13-digit GGN number printed on the label
extract_fields.LotNumber: the lot/batch code printed on the label (e.g. 'L 37 - 01')
extract_fields.VarietyGroup: the produce variety group / commodity name printed on the label (e.g. 'Tafeltrauben, Hell')
extract_fields.PackagingColorTag: the short pre-printed color/style tag on the packaging design near the grape illustration, e.g. 'Hell & Kernlos', 'Rot & Kernlos', or 'Blau & Kernlos' -- this is part of the fixed packaging artwork, not overprinted variable text
